name: Pi-hole Switcher
description: Minimal Pi-hole blocking dashboard (SvelteKit). The FTL API password stays server-side; the browser only ever talks to this app. Proxy target + admin link are prefilled for a Pi-hole at 192.168.1.12:1010 — adjust to taste.

env.name: PIHOLE_API_PASSWORD
env.label: Pi-hole FTL API password (required — FTL v6: Settings → Web server → API password)

env.name: PIHOLE_PROXY_TARGET
env.label: Pi-hole host as seen from the container (LAN IP, or 172.17.0.1 for same-host docker bridge)

env.name: PIHOLE_FTL_PORT
env.label: FTL API port (FTL v6 serves the REST API on 1010, not 8080)

env.name: PUBLIC_PIHOLE_ADMIN
env.label: Pi-hole admin UI URL — optional, defaults to FTL host + /admin
